name: web-synais-founder-quote-and-project-meta-info-block
title: Synais case study 'About Project' slide: a founder pull-quote beside client, category and date meta rows
whatItIs: A maroon slide with 'About Project' label, a large pull-quote from the founder about automating financial reporting with AI, his photo and title, and on the right four meta rows (Client: Synais, Category: FinTech/SaaS/AI Finance Tools, Project: Landing Page Design, Date: 2026).
whatItMeans: Credible and human; a real quote from a named founder grounds an AI product pitch in an actual problem.
techniques: Pair a large pull-quote with the speaker's photo and title.
List project meta as simple label-value rows.
Keep the quote focused on the problem, not the solution.

vocabulary.definition: A quotation set in large type to draw attention.
A line pairing a label with its value.
